methods.annotationMethod: AI-agent semantic close reading; no external model inference or human annotation
methods.sampling: Fixed beginning/middle/ending30second targets and one60second question-marker/topic-keyword enriched target per ASR; segment boundaries can extend targets; first250whitespace words per Daniel item; full Paul PDF extraction; three post-hoc NMF-term windows, deliberate full reading plus a bounded purpose-guidance window in the single Athina comparison source, and four post-hoc entity-spelling contexts
methods.wordCountMethod: Python str.split whitespace tokens for both numerator and denominator; differs from regex counts in some inherited primary metadata
methods.quotePolicy: No raw source text or verbatim quotations in public reading/Q&A artifacts; full windows remain private
methods.qaMeaning: AI paraphrase candidates. Interview, fragmentary, rhetorical/self-question, secondary-report and analyst-constructed authored prompts are separate kinds.
methods.comparisonMeaning: Prompt-family membership is an AI analytic grouping, not validated question equivalence, answer agreement, entity identity, or independent evidence.
